name: Ashtasidhhi Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1993, Ashtasidhhi Industries Ltd is engaged in the textile business[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
AIL was initially registered as a non-systematically important, non-deposit-taking NBFC engaged in lending and financial services. Over time, it altered its business objects to enter the textile sector, adding activities such as ginning, spinning, weaving, and fabric manufacturing. The company has since exited financial services and now operates primarily in textile trading and allied activities, with operations concentrated in Ahmedabad.

cons: Company has a low return on equity of 0.51% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 725 days.
